decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up approach to left plush; reserve white for plush, blue for watches, red for pens. Geometry estimated from RGB.
Align left fingers around plush body while pitching downward, maintaining gradual elbow-up motion.
Center the left plush torso between fingers, descend slightly and close; retention still needs visual confirmation.
Lift closed left gripper to test retention, then start toward the white basket with clearance.
Plush visibly retained; carry it above the white basket before lowering and releasing.
Lower and release the first plush in white, then lift clear. Begin right-arm elbow-up preparation for the right pen.
First plush is released inside white. Move left above the second plush; pitch right downward above its own pen workspace.
Approach second plush from above without crossing arms. Rotate right gripper across the pen's narrow dimension before descent.
Close left around the second plush torso after a small descent. Lower right toward the aligned pen; keep it open until a closer view.
Lift the second plush to verify retention and begin returning toward white. Fine-align and close right around the pen shaft.
Second plush was not retained; reopen and reapproach its shifted torso lower. Lift the closed right gripper to check pen retention.
Grasp the plush lower around its torso and test lift. The pen is visibly retained; carry it toward the red basket.
Plush now appears retained; raise and carry it toward white. Center the held pen farther inside red, lower, and release.
Carry the retained plush over white. Withdraw right with gripper open after pen release and move toward the remaining pen.
Release second plush into white and withdraw. Approach the black pen with right fingers open and aligned across its shaft.
White now contains both plush toys. Approach green watch with left; make a small lateral correction and close right around the black pen.
Lift the closed right gripper to verify black-pen retention. Lower left around the green watch, keeping its jaws open until aligned.
Close left around the green watch and test lift. Black pen remained on the table; reopen right and reapproach lower with a small position correction.
Lift and carry green watch toward blue while keeping left of center. Close right on the centered black pen and test retention with a short lift.
Replan with smaller left increments after continuity rejection, lowering the retained watch over blue. Black pen did not lift; reopen and approach its shaft lower.
Release green watch inside blue and withdraw left. Right fingertips reached the tabletop; make a small sideways correction, close, and lift to test the pen again.
Green watch is settled in blue. Black pen now follows the gripper; carry it toward red while withdrawing the left arm from the shared center.
Center and release the second pen into red. Return left toward its original pose, keeping elbow-up continuity.
Finish left return using small increments after guard rejection. Open right fully to leave both pens in red, then lift and turn toward the remaining watch.
Both pens appear settled in red. Approach the remaining watch with right gripper open, aligning the jaws similarly to the successful green-watch grasp.
Descend around the remaining watch band with a small lateral correction, then close. Retention will be judged after lifting.
Lift the closed right gripper to verify watch retention, then begin moving toward the blue basket with table clearance.
Watch visibly follows the right gripper. Carry it over the right half of blue with small increments and maintain the closed grasp.
Move the retained watch just beyond the front rim of blue, lower, and open to place it beside the green watch.
Both watches are now released in blue. Withdraw the open right gripper upward and back, beginning the continuous elbow-up return to origin.
All six objects appear separated in their baskets. Continue retracting right toward origin with gradual wrist leveling; left remains at origin.
